title: Cell phone bans in schools don't work, new study finds
content:
A new study was released that found, once again, that cell phone bans in schools don’t work. The study examined a group of schools, 20 of which engaged in cellphone restriction, 20 of which did not.

The study, like others before it, found no evidence that restricting student’s access to cellphones improved their wellbeing, nor did it improve their grade…
